findings.F1: The coin's day volume relative to its own 30-day mean volume carries the clearest pattern in the bars. In the top quintile, the excess 3-day return over the coin's mean is +0.0083 (t 2.83, 1061 non-overlapping cases), against -0.0030 to +0.0009 in the four lower quintiles. The top two deciles are +0.0069 and +0.0097, but the lower deciles do not rise in order: decile 0 is +0.0028 and decile 1 is -0.0089.
findings.F2: The volume effect holds up under checks. In a pooled regression with nearness to the 30-day high and the 7-day return, relative volume keeps a t of 2.52 (near 0.77, 7-day return 1.27). The top quintile minus the rest is positive in 5 of 6 coins (BTC -0.0047 is the exception; XRP +0.019, ZEC +0.021), in 7 of 8 years (2018 -0.012 is the exception), and in both halves of the windows (w1-12 +0.012, t 2.99; w13-24 +0.009, t 1.85). Many angles were looked at, so it stands out only moderately.
findings.F3: Nearness to the 30-day high predicts in single sorts but not on its own. The top quintile's excess 3-day return is +0.0073 (t 2.89, 1061 cases) and the second quintile's is -0.0068 (t -2.83). Inside the regression with volume and the 7-day return its t falls to 0.77, and in windows w1-12 the top-minus-rest is only +0.0034 (t 1.04).
findings.F4: Near the high, heavy volume and the high go together. The cell nearest the high with the heaviest volume tercile has an excess 3-day return of +0.0120, while the other heavy-volume cells are +0.0022 and +0.0026. The interaction itself is only t 1.57.
findings.F5: Closes above the prior 30-day high show weak follow-through. They have a mean excess 3-day return of +0.0142 (t 2.25, 217 cases), and 69% are still above that high 3 days later. Low-volume breakouts give -0.0032, against +0.033 and +0.012 in the middle and heavy terciles, but with 72 cases per tercile.
findings.F6: The tested short-on-falling-month book loses. Its mean daily book return is negative in 17 of 24 windows, and it lost most where the coins rose (w11, coin +0.0126 vs book -0.0005). The 30-day return quintiles of the 3-day excess return are not ordered (lowest +0.0003, second -0.0065, highest +0.0051), which fits the Sharpe of -0.27.

ideas.idea: The heavier a coin's day volume relative to its own 30-day average volume, the higher its return over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A day of unusually heavy volume in a coin is a reason to favour a long over the next few days, more firmly the heavier the volume.
ideas.name: heavy volume precedes gains

ideas.idea: The closer a coin closes to its own 30-day high on a day of heavy volume relative to its 30-day average, the higher its return over the next 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A coin pressing its monthly high on heavy volume is a reason to take a long over the next few days rather than fade the high.
ideas.name: heavy volume under the high
